##### Project general facts

Mayfair Gardens by Majid redefines luxury living as a stunning residential development designed to embody the perfect fusion of elegance and modern city life, offering a thoughtfully curated collection of studios and one-bedroom apartments. This exceptional address is not merely a residence but an invitation to immerse yourself in a dynamic and enchanting spirit, featuring a striking architectural design with lush vertical gardens and flowing curves that create a distinctive presence. Fully furnished and freehold, every residence has been meticulously crafted to provide a sanctuary of refined comfort where sophistication and contemporary style exist in perfect harmony.

The amenities at Mayfair Gardens are truly world-class, offering an unparalleled lifestyle defined by relaxation, wellness, and social connection. Residents enjoy a breathtaking infinity pool with sweeping views of the iconic city skyline, a state-of-the-art fitness center, dedicated yoga and viewing decks, and beautifully landscaped garden spaces perfect for quiet reflection. Exclusive lounges, a lush chic bar area, a barbecue terrace, and engaging social spaces including chess, pool table, foosball, and table tennis ensure that every moment at home is enriched with comfort, leisure, and community.

The interiors of Mayfair Gardens are a celebration of refined elegance, featuring high-quality finishes, exquisite marble accents, and contemporary fittings that exude sophistication throughout. Each residence boasts spacious living areas flooded with natural light, serene bedrooms with floor-to-ceiling windows framing breathtaking city views, and lavish bathrooms adorned with marble finishes and high-end fixtures that offer a spa-like retreat. The hi-end kitchens are outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, seamlessly combining modern technology with functional design to elevate every culinary experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a prime area located in the heart of Dubai, known for its strategic positioning and accessibility. Situated close to Sheikh Zayed Road, one of Dubai’s main arterial roads, the area provides residents and businesses with easy access to key parts of the city, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Dubai International Airport. This location makes it a highly sought-after spot for both residential and commercial developments, catering to professionals, families, and businesses looking for a central and convenient setting.

The area is designed to offer a balanced blend of urban living and natural beauty, featuring a mix of high-rise buildings, mid-rise residential complexes, and villas surrounded by lush landscaping. Jumeirah Garden City is planned to include extensive green spaces, parks, and water features, creating a serene environment amidst the urban landscape. This integration of nature within the city is intended to promote a sense of community and well-being among its residents, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

In addition to its residential offerings, Jumeirah Garden City host a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and entertainment options, making it a self-sufficient neighborhood with everything residents need within easy reach. The development aims to enhance the quality of life for its inhabitants by providing modern amenities, recreational facilities, and community spaces that encourage social interaction and a healthy lifestyle. Its commitment to combining luxury living with environmental sustainability and urban convenience makes Jumeirah Garden City a unique and desirable destination in Dubai.
